settings.headline: Four phases. Fixed fees.
settings.subtitle: You pay for drawings by phase. You can stop after any phase and keep what we made.

settings.headline: Phases and what they cost (story figures)
settings.intro: Figures below are the fictional example's story numbers for a typical 1,400 sq ft rammed-earth house. Your quote is fixed after we walk your land.

items.b: I walk the land, check water, septic and county rules, and test whether rammed earth suits your soil. Written summary with a sketch and a rough build-cost range.
Plans, sections, and a clay or foam model. We move walls on paper while it is cheap. Two revision rounds included.
Construction drawings a builder can price: structure, septic, electrical, details for thick walls and deep shade. County submittal and responses.
I visit at footing, wall lifts, roof, and finishes. Phone photos from the builder between visits; I answer for the drawings.

settings.headline: What I don't charge for
settings.body: First 30-minute call. Telling you not to hire me. Recommending a builder or engineer. Saying 'that idea will cost more than it's worth' in phase 01 instead of phase 04.
settings.side: In this story, recent houses built at $385–$520 per sq ft depending on water/septic distance. If your budget is below that, we design smaller — not cheaper walls.
